async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Click on 'Epoch & Drift Benchmark' link to navigate to the homepage
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Epoch & Drift Benchmark").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("load")
    # Step 2: From the homepage, find and click the target article link
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Beijing extends Mars mission lead; stranded astronauts back home: China’s year in space").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("load")
    # Step 3: Use the knowledge base function to extract images from the article page
    result = await extract_images_from_page_manual(page, page.url)
    # Return the result as-is; the function will handle termination
    return result
